$comment: Single source of truth for the estimated parts of the profile. Edit a pct here and the workflow redraws the bars — never edit badges by hand. Colors are derived (>=70 green, 30-69 yellow, <30 grey). Versions and counts are fetched live by scripts/update-profile.mjs.

products.name: Atlas Commerce (web core)
products.reading: `{{version}}` pre-1.0 blockers closed on main; `src/` and `worker/` both type-check at **0 errors** and the guards hold them there. DGI clearance still runs on the stub adapter until the official platform opens

products.name: Atlas Commerce Android
products.reading: `{{version}}` — Android 11+ (`minSdk 30`); queue replay, retry policy and receipt guards covered by 18 contract tests in CI, printer permission guard added for Android 12+

products.name: Atlas Commerce Desktop
products.reading: On hold at `0.3.2` — paused until the login issue is fixed. Builds for Windows, Linux and macOS; packages are unsigned on purpose until there is a public release

products.name: Atlas Shop
products.reading: Not started — the next major build

products.name: Support portal
products.reading: **Not the in-app `/support` page.** A separate help platform: knowledge base, ticket submission and history, status page — reading the same customer records as Atlas Commerce. Only the `SUPPORT-SYNC` hooks and the in-app contact page exist so far

products.name: One connected platform
products.reading: Commerce, Android and the offline contract are live; Shop and the Support portal are the missing halves of the platform

products.name: Atlas Bot + Discord
products.reading: Coming soon — Discord bot and community server

roadmap.scope: Blocker sweep done on main (#215, #216): DGI mounted, dunning fixed, blank-D1 migrations green in CI, payroll gate aligned. Remaining: DGI live submission once the official platform opens
Contract tests, conflict/rejected split and held-write exit merged (#131); one polish pass left, then the 2.0 release
Paused: not extended until the login issue is fixed on web. Windows, Linux and macOS all build in CI; packages stay unsigned until a public release is planned
New repository; products, prices, stock availability and media read live from Atlas Commerce via Partner API v1
A separate help portal — not the in-app contact page: knowledge base, ticket submission and history, status page, and tickets linked to real customer and order records
Cart, orders, payment options, stock reservation written back to the ERP
Idempotent offline-operations contract live across web and Android; extend to Shop and Support
Full module parity and signed auto-updates. Signing comes with the first public release, not before
Single sign-on across products, one alert inbox, one customer view
Adapter, state machine, archive and RBAC are live and tested; submissions still go through the stub until the official DGI platform publishes its API
Documentation, polish, migrations, v1.x across every client — one platform
